content: For CLI-launched local servers, EADDRINUSE (port already in use) should be handled by probing/allocating a free port automatically (e.g. get-port library) rather than crashing or forcing a fixed port. get-port's returned ports are held via a short-lived internal lock (15-30s) to avoid in-process race conditions; use the reserve option for long gaps between allocation and bind. Cross-platform port-conflict tools also support a preferred port with graceful fallback plus a --port flag override, and print the actual bound port/URL clearly since it may differ from the default.
